subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should no-payload read-only exec/bash tool failures surface a compact user-visible warning or incomplete-turn fallback when no assistant reply was delivered?
rationale: Source inspection shows the remaining path, but changing this behavior affects the balance between useful failure visibility and suppressing benign or sensitive tool-error noise.

options.title: Narrow no-reply repair
options.body: Allow compact warnings or fallback text only when a read-only exec-like failure would otherwise deliver zero user-visible payloads, with tests proving acknowledged and recoverable cases stay quiet.

options.title: Keep current suppression
options.body: Treat the beta image-placeholder fix as sufficient and keep read-only exec-like failures quiet unless verbose, cron, heartbeat, or mutating-action policy already surfaces them.

options.title: Split policy follow-up
options.body: Close only the image-placeholder portion through the fixed related issues and open a separate maintainer-owned terminal-error policy item for the remaining fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Narrow no-reply repair
recommendation.body: Allow compact warnings or fallback text only when a read-only exec-like failure would otherwise deliver zero user-visible payloads, with tests proving acknowledged and recoverable cases stay quiet.

likelyOwner.reason: The related terminal-classifier history and maintainer-side close decisions make steipete the clearest owner for the terminal warning/fallback policy choice.
